lead.titleZh: 肩部问题评估量表SPAS：新型评估工具的开发与心理测量学验证
lead.titleEn: SPAS: Development and Psychometric Validation of a New Shoulder Problems Assessment Scale
lead.paragraphZh: 今日日报共7个条目，涵盖5个专科。骨科与肌骨仍是重点，其中“肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS) 的开发与心理测量学验证”这篇观察研究，以80分的curatedScore脱颖而出，值得临床PT花时间关注。神经康复也有2篇观察研究，分数位于中上。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's daily features 7 entries across 5 specialties, with a continued focus on orthopedics and musculoskeletal health. The observational study on the “Development and psychometric validation of the shoulder problems assessment scale (SPAS)” stands out with a curatedScore of 80, warranting clinical PTs’ attention. Neurorehabilitation also presents 2 observational studies with above-average scores.

items.title: Development and psychometric validation of the shoulder problems assessment scale.
items.summary: A 12-item Shoulder Problems Assessment Scale (SPAS) was developed and validated using a multicenter design (n=415) to provide an activity-based patient-reported outcome measure with a hierarchical stepwise yes/no format for identifying the first threshold of difficulty during daily activities.
items.curatedReason: SPAS 是一个基于活动的肩部患者报告结局量表，采用层级式是/否格式，有望在日常临床中更直观地评估患者功能。它提供了一种标准化、易于解释的工具，助您更好地追踪肩部患者的进展。
items.titleZh: 肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS) 的开发与心理测量学验证
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心研究（n=415）开发并验证了 12 项肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS)，该量表采用基于活动的层级式是/否格式，旨在识别日常活动中首次出现困难的阈值。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SPAS is an activity-based shoulder patient-reported outcome measure using a hierarchical yes/no format, offering intuitive functional assessment in routine clinical practice. It provides a standardized, easily interpretable tool to better track shoulder patient progress.
items.limitation: 研究样本仅来自门诊物理治疗中心，可能限制其在其他设置（如住院或运动康复）的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study sample was drawn only from outpatient physical therapy centers, potentially limiting its generalizability to other settings like inpatient or sports rehabilitation.

items.title: Beyond treatment: how care process factors shape physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.summary: This commentary synthesizes emerging evidence on how care process factors, such as timing of care, point of entry, and care pathway design, independently influence outcomes in physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 本述评梳理了影响腰痛物理治疗效果的流程因素，包括及时性、首诊类型和支付模式。这些非治疗性因素在临床实践中往往被忽视，但对患者结局有显著影响，提示您优化服务交付流程的重要性。
items.titleZh: 超越治疗：护理流程因素如何塑造物理治疗师对腰痛的管理
items.summaryZh: 本述评探讨了护理流程因素（如护理及时性、初始提供者类型和护理路径设计）如何独立于具体治疗，影响物理治疗师管理腰痛的患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights crucial care process factors—timeliness, entry point, and payment models—that influence low back pain physical therapy outcomes. These often-overlooked non-treatment elements significantly impact patient recovery, urging you to optimize service delivery processes.

items.title: Intensive, Multi-Technology Rehabilitation Programme for Chronic Stroke Survivors: Outcomes of a Phase I Single-Arm Repeated-Measures Study.
items.summary: An 8-week, single-arm, repeated-measures study observed changes in motor recovery outcomes in chronic stroke survivors (n=20) participating in an intensive, group-based, multi-technology rehabilitation program.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究展示了慢性卒中幸存者通过多技术康复方案改善运动功能的潜力。虽然是单臂研究，但其结果提示，结合多种技术能为长期卒中残障患者提供有效的康复路径。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者的强化多技术康复方案：一项 I 期单臂重复测量研究的结果
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的单臂重复测量研究观察了 20 名慢性卒中幸存者在参与强化、基于小组的多技术康复方案后运动恢复结局的变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reveals the potential of multi-technology rehabilitation programs to improve motor function in chronic stroke survivors. While a single-arm study, its results suggest that integrating various technologies can offer an effective rehabilitation pathway for individuals with long-term stroke disability.
items.limitation: 本研究为单臂设计，缺乏对照组，无法确证干预的因果效应。
items.limitationEn: This study used a single-arm design, lacking a control group, which prevents conclusive causal inferences about the intervention's effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Direct observation methods for assessing inpatient movement behaviour in hospitals: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and synthesized direct observation methods used for assessing inpatient movement behavior at the ward level, aiming to enhance methodological clarity for evaluating physical activity interventions in hospital settings.
items.curatedReason: 评估住院患者运动行为，直接观察是常用手段，但这项综述明确指出目前尚无统一的标准化方案。设计院内活动干预研究时，你需要了解现有方法的广度，但务必记得自行验证所选工具在你特定环境下的可靠性和有效性。
items.titleZh: 直接观察法评估住院患者运动行为的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并综合了在病房层面评估住院患者运动行为的直接观察方法，旨在提升住院环境物理活动干预评估的方法学清晰度。
items.curatedReasonEn: For assessing inpatient movement, direct observation is common, but this review confirms a lack of standardized, unified methods. When designing ward-level activity interventions, you need to understand the range of existing approaches, but be sure to validate your chosen tool's reliability and validity within your specific clinical setting.
items.limitation: 本综述仅关注观察方法，未能评估这些方法的测量学质量或提供标准化的协议。
items.limitationEn: This review focused solely on observation methods and did not assess the psychometric quality of these methods or provide standardized protocols.

items.title: The relationship between the uric acid to prealbumin ratio and frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients: a retrospective cross-sectional study
items.summary: A retrospective cross-sectional study investigated the relationship between the uric acid to prealbumin ratio and frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients.
items.curatedReason: 尿酸与前白蛋白比值可能成为评估老年门诊患者衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险的生物标志物。这个指标可辅助你早期识别高风险老年患者，以便及时进行康复和营养干预。
items.titleZh: 老年门诊患者尿酸与前白蛋白比值与衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险的关系：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性横断面研究探讨了老年门诊患者尿酸与前白蛋白比值与衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险之间的关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: The uric acid to prealbumin ratio may serve as a biomarker for assessing frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients. This metric can assist you in early identification of high-risk older patients for timely rehabilitation and nutritional interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，结果需前瞻性研究验证。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality, and its findings require validation by prospective studies.

items.title: Does surgical approach or preoperative deformity better predict outcomes in thoracolumbar fractures? A comparative study of minimally invasive versus open techniques
items.summary: A comparative study investigates whether surgical approach (minimally invasive vs. open) or preoperative deformity better predicts outcomes in thoracolumbar fractures.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究比较了微创与开放技术治疗胸腰椎骨折的结局预测因素。在为胸腰椎骨折患者制定康复计划时，你应该了解外科手术方式和术前畸形对预后的影响，以便更好地与外科团队协作并管理患者预期。
items.titleZh: 胸腰椎骨折中，手术入路或术前畸形哪个更能预测预后？一项微创与开放技术的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项比较研究探讨了胸腰椎骨折中，是手术入路（微创 vs. 开放）还是术前畸形更能预测预后。
items.curatedReasonEn: For thoracolumbar fractures, preoperative deformity is a better predictor of rehabilitation outcomes than surgical approach (minimally invasive vs. open). When assessing these patients, considering preoperative deformity as a key factor may offer better insight into their functional recovery trajectory than focusing solely on the surgical approach.
items.limitation: 这是一项比较外科手术方法的研究，并未直接评估物理治疗干预的有效性或优化方案。
items.limitationEn: This study compares surgical approaches and does not directly evaluate the effectiveness or optimization of physical therapy interventions.

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $90 million to Modernize and Improve IT and Interoperability for South Dakota
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $90 million grant to modernize and improve IT and interoperability for healthcare systems in South Dakota.
items.curatedReason: 此新闻是关于南达科他州通用医疗IT现代化和互操作性的拨款，与物理治疗的临床执业或行业发展无直接关联。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款9000万美元用于南达科他州IT现代化和互操作性改善
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款9000万美元，旨在改善南达科他州的医疗信息技术现代化和互操作性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This news is about a grant for general healthcare IT modernization and interoperability in South Dakota, which is not directly related to physical therapy clinical practice or industry development.
